then.text: Pollitt's Launderette and Dry Cleaning. Alterations while you wait. Questions while you don't.
The brook? I've never been near it. Why would I? I have a very nice machine. Tuesday? Tuesday I do the, er, tablecloths. Not anywhere near a brook.
He is sweating through a freshly pressed shirt.

else.text: Shirt? Trousers? Alterations while you wait.

wirral_h2_0.text: Chipgulls steal chips off the front. Never eat with your back to the sea. Tide table is on the fridge.
'Sound' means all right round here. I say it about the weather, the neighbours and my own cooking.
